config.self_exclusion: candidate leave-all-own-occurrences-out, original minmax, clip [0,1], no extra old-score cap
config.generic_control: uniform vs uniform_penalty; both alpha=.3; separate native reference
config.stop_after: all four main arms and uniform controls on all1024/domain; no automatic next experiment

statistical_review.simpson: Domains, batches, and blocks separated; no cross-domain selected winner.
statistical_review.ecological: Per-user gains/losses retained; no universal user benefit claim.
statistical_review.berkson: Fixed eligible validation cohort, not raw population.
statistical_review.collider: User selection uses indices, never outcomes.
statistical_review.base_rate: Every prescribed user retained in every arm.
statistical_review.regression_to_mean: Repeated development exploration, no independent confirmation claim.
statistical_review.survivorship: All arms and failures retained; incomplete cannot summarize as complete.
statistical_review.look_elsewhere: All planned intervals saved; unadjusted and descriptive.
statistical_review.forking_paths: Lambda, cohort, alpha, beta, and scorer frozen before generation.
statistical_review.causation: Conditional ablation of this frozen system; uniform prior control is explicit, not pure native-only penalty.
statistical_review.reverse_causality: Targets absent from scoring API and model encoding; metrics only.
